documentText:
Acme Corp (NASDAQ: ACME) today reported financial results for its first quarter of fiscal 2026 (Q1 2026), ended March 31, 2026.

Total revenue was $1.24 billion, up 12.4% year-over-year. GAAP diluted earnings per share was $1.15; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.32. Non-GAAP operating margin was 22.1%.

Segment revenue: Cloud segment revenue was $700 million. Hardware segment revenue was $540 million.

The company issued guidance for Q2 2026 revenue of $1.28 billion to $1.32 billion, an increase from prior guidance of $1.22 billion to $1.26 billion.

During the quarter, Acme announced a restructuring of its hardware division and a transition of its Chief Financial Officer.

CEO Jane Smith said: "We're seeing strong momentum in enterprise adoption, and our cloud segment continues to outperform our expectations."
